recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic, multi-layered portrait featuring a central figure with motion-blurred transitions between a natural profile and a face-painted 'warrior' persona. The aesthetic is defined by high-contrast lighting, vibrant neon face paint, and a dark, atmospheric background with a grainy, analog texture.
coreVisualRelationships: The transition from natural skin tones on the left to vibrant blue and red face paint on the right.
The relationship between the sharp facial features and the soft, streaking motion blur connecting them.
The contrast between the deep black negative space and the glowing, saturated highlights of the makeup.
coreInvariants: Motion blur trailing from left to right
Vibrant blue and red face paint patterns

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centralized, filling the middle horizontal band of the frame with a large-scale head-and-shoulders view.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The sharp, natural eye on the left side of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the motion blur from the natural profile on the left across to the painted face on the right, then up to the top-center typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space at the top and bottom edges, framing the central action.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and dark charcoal for the background and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm skin tones and peach highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Electric blue and saturated magenta/red in the face paint and lighting streaks.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the makeup against a low-value, low-saturation background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid pastel or muted earth tones

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, slanted sans-serif with brush-stroke terminals.
letterConstructionRules: Thick, gestural strokes with visible dry-brush textures
Interlocking or overlapping characters to create a unified block
Underlined with a thick, tapered brush stroke
characterSpecificRedesigns: The initial 'S' is oversized and wraps slightly over the following letters
Terminals are jagged and uneven to simulate hand-painting
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A clean, small geometric sans-serif for secondary metadata and a fluid, thin script for the 'featuring' credit.
graphicDevices: Motion streaks extending from letter edges

avoid: Thin, delicate fonts for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Necessary to achieve the specific interlocking brush look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a woman with 80s hair, using a long exposure effect to show a transition from a natural face on the left to a face with neon blue and red warrior paint on the right. Use a dark, grainy background with red light streaks.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, white, hand-painted brush-style title at the top center, slanted to the right, with a thick brush underline. Add secondary text in a thin, elegant script below the main title.

verificationChecks: Is the motion blur consistent from left to right?
Does the typography have a visible dry-brush texture?
Is the face paint vibrant and high-contrast against the skin?
Is the background sufficiently dark to make the neon pop?

adjustableVariables: Complexity of the face paint patterns
Thickness of the brush strokes in the typography
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the model
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not look like a standard system font.
Check that the motion blur doesn't obscure the eyes entirely.
Verify the color palette stays within the neon/dark contrast range.
Confirm the composition maintains the heavy top/bottom negative space.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine long-exposure portraiture with aggressive, hand-painted brush typography and a high-contrast neon-on-black color scheme to evoke 1980s new wave energy.
